items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 very fun, I don't need to clear main sto
items.summary: very fun, I don't need to clear main story to level up my characters like other games. instead, I only need to clear things that are intended for higher leveled players. it's not so hard once you level up your main 4 characters. easy to get the wheel of destinies (weapon) and enlightens (copies) of the characters. pity is 30 and you'll get the limited SSR guaranteed after losing two times. very generous with silvers and pulls. standard characters are also very good for beginners.
items.author: Mafuyu Asahina
